# Drownedcity audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/drownedcity-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set drownedcity` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `water.mp3` is cut from "230101 Water gentle calm lapping, boat-tailed ducks, R-07 EM272s, Colonel Samuel Smith Park, Lake Ontario, Toronto 1pm" by TRP, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/TRP/sounds/717838/.
- `gulls.mp3` is cut from "Colony Blackheaded Gulls Zwillbrock.mp3" by Tom Corax, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Tom%20Corax/sounds/554806/.
